title: runtime: localize the remaining fixed-English 501 refusals (about 26 sentences across auth, i18n, mcp, meta, packages and automation)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (split out of #37737's fifth item, measured on `main` by the card thread) · Source: fleet (review follow-ups of PR #37721, sized by the #37737 thread on 2026-11-27)

## What happens

PR #37721 localized the own-door `501` refusals for the doors it touched, following the reader's `Accept-Language`. The other fixed-English `501`s in `packages/runtime/src/domains/` still answer English to every reader. The #37737 thread counted them on `main`:

| Module | Fixed-English `501` sentences |
|---|---|
| `auth.ts` | 1 |
| `i18n.ts` | 1 |
| `mcp.ts` | 2 |
| `meta.ts` | 4 |
| `packages.ts` | 8 |
| `automation.ts` | about 10 (cancel, list runs, restore, resume, screen and flow clone included) |

That is about 26 sentences in all.

## Expected

- Each sentence comes from the operation-message catalog with `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` translations. Use the platform's existing terms: Japanese says `自動化`, as #37737 aligns.
- Each door has a per-door pin.
- Each localized `501` carries `Vary: Accept-Language`, as #37737 sets the pattern. A `501` is cacheable by default under RFC 9111.
- Any sentence left in English needs a stated reason.

Size: M. Split from #37737, where it was item 5, because it is larger than that S card.
Reader: the ux i18n area (seat 2, s2-ux-T), after #37737's PR lands.
Grade: area:ux · Bug · minor · reach: measured (counts read on `main`) → p2, the grade of its parent follow-up.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `fixed-English 501`: 0 hits.
Related: #37737, PR #37721.
